"""Matcher worst case: full AND chains, no early exit, no match."""
import random, sys, time
sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/site'); sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/submission')
from online_matching.match_p4 import Matcher

rng = random.Random(3)
pool = [v for v in range(0, 3028) if v != 1514]   # never 3028
kept = []
for i in range(4000):
    L = 2 + (i % 15)
    pat = [[0, 3028]] * (L-1) + [[3028, 3028]]   # last coord never matches
    kept.append((i, i % 2, pat))
t0 = time.time()
m = Matcher(kept)
print('build %.2fs' % (time.time()-t0))
feats = [pool[rng.randrange(len(pool))] for _ in range(20000)]
t0 = time.time()
for k in range(2, 200002):
    r = m.best(feats, (k % 19990) + 2)
print('200k hard queries %.2fs (res=%s)' % (time.time()-t0, r))
EOF
cd /workspace/tmp/dev && bash -c 'ulimit -v 1048576; LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/workspace/native python3 bench_matcher2.py'
